## Setup
```{r}
library("GimmmeMySC")
library("GimmeMyPlot")
library("Seurat")
library("rlist")
library("cowplot")

source(
  file.path(file.path(
  dirname(getwd()),
  "inst",
  "extdata"
), "conf.R"))

cell_label <- "cell_subtype_formatted"

if (assay != "ATAC") {
  features <- c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent_mitochondrial", "percent_ribosomal")
} else {
  features <- c(
    paste0("nCount", "_", assay),
    paste0("nFeature", "_", assay),
    "nucleosome_signal",
    "TSS.enrichment",
    "percent_reads_in_peaks",
    "blacklist_ratio"
  )
}
```

```{r}
load(file.path(path_data, paste0(seurat_dataset, ".rda")))

seurat_subset <- subsampling_sc(seurat) %>%
  subset(subset = Type == target_type)
  
if (split.by != "Type") {
  load(file.path(path_data, paste0(seurat_dataset, "_", target_type, ".rda")))
  pal_discrete_sc <- palette_continuous()(nlevels(Idents(seurat)))
  seurat_subset <- subset(seurat, cells = Cells(seurat_subset))
}
seurat_subset$cell_subtype_formatted <-  fct_drop(seurat_subset$cell_subtype_formatted)

if (split.by == "Type") {
  seurat <- subset(
      seurat,
      subset = Type == target_type
  )
  seurat$cell_subtype_formatted <-  fct_drop(seurat$cell_subtype_formatted)
} else {
  pal_discrete_sc2 <- palette_continuous()(length(unique(seurat$cell_subtype_formatted)))
}
```

## Annotation (1)
```{r}
lim <- 25
tab <- table(seurat$cell_subtype_formatted, seurat[[]][, split.by])
cell_types_low <- rownames(tab)[apply(tab, 1, function(x) any(x < lim))]

seurat$cell_subtype_formatted2[seurat$cell_subtype_formatted2 %in% cell_types_low] <- NA
seurat$cell_subtype_formatted2 <- fct_drop(seurat$cell_subtype_formatted2)
```

```{r}
bar_group_ident(
    seurat,
    idents = "cell_subtype_formatted2",
    group.by = "Type",
    colour = pal_discrete_sc2
)

list.map(
  unique(seurat_subset[[]][, split.by]),
  f(i) ~{
  tmp <- seurat_subset
  tmp[[]][, split.by][seurat_subset[[]][, split.by] != i] <- NA
  plot_dim(
    tmp,
    group.by = split.by,
    label = FALSE, 
    na.value = "grey"
  ) +
    NoLegend() +
    ggtitle(i)
  }
)
```

```{r}
bar_group_ident(
    seurat,
    idents = "cell_subtype_formatted2",
    group.by = "Patient",
    colour = pal_discrete_sc2
)
```

## Annotation
### Main cell types
```{r}
Idents(seurat) <- cell_label
plot_bar_sc(seurat)

Idents(seurat) %>% 
    cluster_size() %>% 
    kable_sc(file = file.path(path_fig, "table_cells.png"))

plot_dim_cell(seurat_subset, col = pal_discrete_sc)
```

```{r, message = FALSE, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 10}
plot_dim_cell(
    seurat_subset,
    group.by = cell_label,
    split.by = cell_label,
    ncol = 3,
    label = FALSE,
    col = rep("black", 100)
) + NoLegend()
```


```{r, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 10}
top_cells <- seurat_subset$cell_subtype_formatted2 %>% fct_infreq() %>% levels() %>% head(12) %>% reorder_celltype()
seurat_subset$cell_subtype_formatted3 <- seurat_subset$cell_subtype_formatted2
seurat_subset$cell_subtype_formatted3[!seurat_subset$cell_subtype_formatted3 %in% top_cells] <- NA
Idents(seurat_subset) <- "cell_subtype_formatted3"
plot_dim_cell(
    seurat_subset,
    split.by = "cell_subtype_formatted3",
    label = FALSE,
    ncol = 3, 
    cols = rep("black", 100)
) +
    NoLegend()
```

```{r, fig.width = 5}
plot_dim_cell(seurat_subset, cols = pal_discrete_sc2)
```

```{r, message = FALSE, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 10}
cell_categories <- seurat_subset$cell_type_formatted %>% unique() %>% na.omit()

list.map(
  cell_categories,
    f(x, y, z) ~ {
      cells <- WhichCells(seurat_subset, expression = cell_type_formatted == x)
      if(length(cells) > 50)
        plot_dim(
            seurat_subset,
            group.by = "cell_subtype_formatted",
            cells = cells,
            cols = rep(palette_discrete(), 5),
            pt.size = .25
        ) +
        labs(title = z, x = NULL)
    }
) %>% compact() %>%
plot_grid(plotlist = ., align = "hv", nrow = 2)
```

```{r, message = FALSE, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 12}
cell_list <- map(cell_categories, ~ {
  seurat$cell_subtype[str_detect(seurat$cell_subtype, paste0("^", .x))] %>% na.omit() %>% keep_parenthesis()
}) %>%
  set_names(cell_categories) %>%
  .[order(lengths(.), decreasing = TRUE)]

p <- list.map(
  compact(cell_list),
  f(x, y, z) ~ plot_bar_sc(x, z)
)

n_max <- min(length(p), 9)
plot_grid(plotlist = p[seq(n_max)])
```

```{r, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 10}
Idents(seurat) <- cell_label
plot_sc_violin(
    seurat,
    nrow = 2,
    ncol = 2,
    normalize = c(10, 10, 10, 10),
    breaks = list(
      c(0, 1e3, 2.5e3, 5e3, 1e4),
      c(0, 1e3, 2.5e3, 5e3, 1e4),
      c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 2.5, 5, 10),
      c(0.1, 1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 1e3)
    ),
    col = pal_discrete_sc2
)
```
